description: This source file implements the ViewModel and UI components for onboarding wizard steps in a macOS application, including logic for starting, submitting, canceling wizard sessions, and rendering different step types in SwiftUI.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A SwiftUI ObservableObject class managing the onboarding wizard's state, handling session management, progress, and interaction with backend services.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardStepView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders an onboarding step according to its type, providing user interaction mechanisms and submitting answers.

methods.name: bridgeToLocal
methods.description: Converts ProtocolAnyCodable to local AnyCodable, handling JSON encoding/decoding to resolve type conflicts.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the onboarding wizard session if conditions are met, handling gateway readiness and starting the wizard process.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits user input for a given wizard step to the backend and updates the wizard state based on the response.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing wizard session if it is active.

methods.name: applyStartResult
methods.description: Updates the model state based on the result of starting a wizard session.

methods.name: applyNextResult
methods.description: Updates the model state based on the result of advancing to the next wizard step.

methods.name: applyStatusResult
methods.description: Updates the model state after checking or changing wizard session status.

methods.name: restartIfSessionLost
methods.description: Handles session loss errors by attempting to restart the wizard session if conditions permit.

methods.name: shouldSkipWizard
methods.description: Determines if the onboarding wizard should be skipped based on configuration.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the SwiftUI view for displaying a wizard step, handling different step types.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the submission of user responses for the current wizard step.
